heading.zh-Hant: 出身、一戰與律師生涯
heading.en: Origins, the First World War and the bar

body.zh-Hant: 據澳洲戰爭紀念館（AWM）人物頁，埃德蒙·赫林1892年9月2日生於維多利亞州馬里伯勒，1912年獲羅德獎學金。第一次世界大戰期間，他受任於英國皇家野戰炮兵，在法國與馬其頓服役，獲頒傑出服務勳章與軍功十字勳章。戰後他回牛津讀完法律學位，返回墨爾本執業為大律師，1936年成為御用大律師，同時仍在民兵中服役。
body.en: Per the Australian War Memorial, Edmund Herring was born at Maryborough, Victoria, on 2 September 1892 and was awarded a Rhodes Scholarship in 1912. In the First World War he was commissioned into the British Royal Field Artillery and served in France and Macedonia, earning the DSO and the MC. After the war he completed his law degree at Oxford, worked as a barrister in Melbourne, became a King's Counsel in 1936, and continued to serve in the militia.

heading.zh-Hant: 第6師炮兵、北非與希臘戰役、北領地部隊
heading.en: 6th Division artillery, North Africa, Greece and Northern Territory Force

body.zh-Hant: 1939年，赫林重返全職軍旅，出任第6師炮兵指揮官，在布萊梅（Blamey）將軍麾下參加北非與希臘戰役；AWM展覽頁稱他1941年8月獲任該師師長。太平洋戰爭初期他指揮北領地部隊（Northern Territory Force），來源稱他大幅提升了該部隊抵禦日軍進攻的戰備。
body.en: In 1939 Herring returned to full-time service as commander of the 6th Division's artillery under General Blamey and saw action in North Africa and Greece; the AWM exhibition page says he was given command of the division in August 1941. In the early months of the Pacific war he commanded Northern Territory Force, which the source says he transformed to repel any Japanese attack.

heading.zh-Hant: 新幾內亞部隊司令與新幾內亞戰役
heading.en: Commander, New Guinea Force, and the New Guinea campaign

body.zh-Hant: 1942年9月，赫林接替遭撤換的悉尼·羅厄爾（Sydney Rowell）中將，出任新幾內亞部隊（New Guinea Force）司令，這是他第一次指揮正式作戰編制。他負責新幾內亞的主要攻勢，日軍被逐回海岸，其後在薩拉毛阿、萊城與芬什港展開作戰。他保有指揮權至1943年10月；1943年他兼轄澳洲第1軍並受封KBE。也有人認為他1942至1943年表現不佳。
body.en: In September 1942 Herring succeeded the sacked Lieutenant General Sydney Rowell as commander of New Guinea Force, his first operational command of a formation. He became responsible for the main Australian offensives in New Guinea, the enemy was driven back to the coast, and later operations were conducted against Salamaua, Lae and Finschhafen. He kept the command until October 1943; in 1943 he added the 1st Australian Corps and was created KBE. Some considered his performance in 1942-43 poor.

heading.zh-Hant: 第1軍軍長與新幾內亞掃蕩
heading.en: I Australian Corps and the New Guinea operations

body.zh-Hant: 據美國陸軍軍史中心的CARTWHEEL官方戰史，1943年8月20日布萊梅（Blamey）抵達莫士比港並接掌新幾內亞部隊，赫林則前往多布杜拉，以澳洲第1軍軍長身分掌握戰術作戰，該階段作戰目標為奪取馬卡姆河谷與休恩半島。據《澳洲人物辭典》，盟軍在此期間成功攻取萊城、薩拉馬瓦與芬什港；赫林任第1軍軍長至1944年2月，隨後宣誓就任維多利亞州首席法官，現役生涯就此結束。
body.en: Per the US Army Center of Military History's CARTWHEEL volume, General Blamey arrived at Port Moresby and assumed command of New Guinea Force on 20 August 1943, and Herring went to Dobodura, where as general officer commanding the I Australian Corps he exercised control over tactical operations in the campaign for the Markham Valley and the Huon Peninsula. According to the Australian Dictionary of Biography, the Allied forces in this period carried out successful assaults on Lae, Salamaua and Finschhafen; Herring continued as I Corps commander until February 1944, and his active service ended when he was sworn in as chief justice of Victoria.

heading.zh-Hant: 首席法官、副總督與去世
heading.en: Chief Justice, Lieutenant-Governor and death

body.zh-Hant: 1944年2月2日，維多利亞州政府任命赫林為維多利亞最高法院首席法官，他任此職至1964年，被評為優秀的法官與稱職的行政人才。他也擔任維多利亞副總督（Lieutenant-Governor）達27年的紀錄，1972年80歲時卸任。赫林1982年1月5日在墨爾本去世，獲國葬。
body.en: On 2 February 1944 the Victorian Government appointed Herring Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Victoria, a post he held until 1964, earning a reputation as a fine judge and able administrator. He was Lieutenant-Governor of Victoria for a record 27 years, retiring at 80 in 1972. Herring died in Melbourne on 5 January 1982 and was given a state funeral.

heading.en: Origins and early career

body.zh-Hant: 威廉·伯德伍德（William Riddell Birdwood）1865年9月13日生於印度基爾基，就讀克利夫頓學院與桑赫斯特皇家軍事學院，1883年加入皇家蘇格蘭燧發槍團。1885至1899年他在印度任騎兵軍官；1899至1902年在南非擔任基欽納（Kitchener）勛爵的幕僚。1911年晉升少將，1912年起任印度陸軍部秘書。
body.en: William Riddell Birdwood was born at Kirkee, India, on 13 September 1865, was educated at Clifton College and Sandhurst, and joined the Royal Scots Fusiliers in 1883. From 1885 to 1899 he served in India as a cavalry officer, and from 1899 to 1902 in South Africa on Lord Kitchener's staff. Promoted major general in 1911, he served as Secretary of the Indian Army Department from 1912.

heading.zh-Hant: 澳新軍團與加里波利戰役
heading.en: ANZAC and the Gallipoli campaign

body.zh-Hant: 1914年11月，基欽納指派伯德伍德指揮駐埃及的澳洲與紐西蘭部隊軍團，即後來的澳新軍團（ANZAC）。加里波利戰役中，他選擇讓軍團在加巴泰佩（Gaba Tepe）一帶進攻，並是唯一反對撤出加里波利的軍團長。他接替漢密爾頓（Hamilton）出任地中海遠征軍司令，1915年10月28日晉升中將，11月19日接掌達達尼爾軍團。
body.en: In November 1914 Kitchener tapped Birdwood to command a corps of the Australian and New Zealand troops in Egypt, soon known as ANZAC. In the Gallipoli campaign he chose to attack with his corps at Gaba Tepe, and he was the only corps commander to oppose the evacuation. He replaced Hamilton as GOC of the Mediterranean Expeditionary Force, was promoted lieutenant general on 28 October 1915 and took command of the Dardanelles Army on 19 November 1915.

body.zh-Hant: 1916年2月17日起，伯德伍德指揮第1澳新軍團（I ANZAC），並於同年9月正式出任澳洲帝國軍（AIF）司令，直至戰爭結束。他的部隊在弗羅梅勒與波濟耶爾（Pozieres）戰役中被他人投入，他並不同意；在第三次伊珀爾戰役中，他的指揮兼具能力與謹慎。1917年11月第1澳新軍團改為澳洲軍團；1918年5月31日他改任英國第五軍司令。
body.en: From 17 February 1916 Birdwood commanded I ANZAC and in September 1916 was formally appointed commander of the AIF, a post he held to the end of the war. His troops were committed to the battles of Fromelles and Pozieres without his concurrence; at Third Ypres his conduct was marked by competence and caution. In November 1917 I ANZAC became the Australian Corps, and on 31 May 1918 he was given command of the British Fifth Army.

body.zh-Hant: 1919年他受封為「安扎克與托特內斯的伯德伍德男爵」，次年巡訪澳洲。他指揮印度北方軍至1925年，該年晉升元帥並出任印度總司令。1930年自軍中退役後，他曾盼出任澳洲總督，但斯卡林政府堅持任命澳洲人。伯德伍德於1951年5月17日去世。
body.en: In 1919 he was created Baron Birdwood of Anzac and Totnes and toured Australia the next year. He commanded the Northern Army in India until 1925, when he was promoted field marshal and became Commander in Chief, India. After retiring in 1930 he hoped to become Governor General of Australia, but the Scullin government insisted on an Australian. He died on 17 May 1951.

body.zh-Hant: 據AIF Project頁面，布魯德內爾·懷特（Cyril Brudenell Bingham White）1876年9月23日生於維多利亞州聖阿爾諾。他1897年受任於第2昆士蘭團，1902年在布爾戰爭中短暫服役；1904年任霍頓（Hutton）少將的副官，其後成為第一位進入英國坎伯利參謀學院的澳洲人。1911年初他奉召回國出任軍事行動處長，擬定遠征軍計畫，成為日後澳洲帝國軍（AIF）的藍本。
body.en: Per the AIF Project, Cyril Brudenell Bingham White was born at St Arnaud, Victoria, on 23 September 1876. He was commissioned into the 2nd Queensland Regiment in 1897 and served briefly in the Boer War in 1902; in 1904 he became ADC to Major General Hutton and then the first Australian to attend the Camberley staff college. Recalled early in 1911 as Director of Military Operations, he drew up the expeditionary force plan that became the blueprint for the AIF.

heading.zh-Hant: AIF 參謀長與加里波利撤退
heading.en: AIF chief of staff and the Gallipoli evacuation

body.zh-Hant: 1914年戰爭爆發時，懷特代理參謀長，爭取國家轉入戰時狀態。布里奇斯（Bridges）受命指揮AIF後，他任其參謀長，協助部隊組建、運往埃及，並參與安扎克登陸計畫，獲DSO。他自加里波利因病後送，十月返回後晉升准將，出任澳新軍團總參謀（BGGS），策劃撤出安扎克；該行動是整個戰役中唯一依計畫完成且無損失的行動。
body.en: When war broke out in 1914 White was acting Chief of Staff and had to get the country on a war footing. When Bridges was appointed to command the AIF White became his chief of staff, helped organise the force and its despatch to Egypt, assisted with plans for the Anzac landing and won the DSO. Evacuated sick from Gallipoli, he returned in October, was promoted brigadier general as BGGS of ANZAC and planned the evacuation of Anzac, the one operation of the campaign to go off according to plan and without loss.

body.zh-Hant: 1920年6月，懷特出任陸軍總參謀長，負責落實軍制改革委員會的建議，但在1920與1922年的國防經費削減下幾乎難以執行。他1923年辭去軍職，出任首任公務員委員會主席，1928年退休。1940年3月15日他被召回現役、晉升上將並再任總參謀長；同年8月13日，他在坎培拉機場附近的空難中喪生。
body.en: In June 1920 White became Chief of the General Staff and had to implement the committee's recommendations, which proved next to impossible amid the 1920 and 1922 defence cuts. He resigned from the Army in 1923 to become the first Chairman of the Public Service Board and retired in 1928. On 15 March 1940 he was recalled, promoted full general and reappointed CGS; he was killed in a plane crash near Canberra Airport on 13 August 1940.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與一戰空戰
heading.en: Birth and First World War air combat

body.zh-Hant: 據澳洲航空遺產博物館（Aviation Heritage Museum）的紀念名冊頁，彼得·德拉蒙德（Peter Roy Maxwell Drummond）1894年6月2日生於西澳珀斯，是在英國皇家空軍服役的澳洲人。該頁稱他是澳洲空戰王牌，在第一次世界大戰西線取得八次空戰勝利。
body.en: Per the Aviation Heritage Museum roll page, Peter Roy Maxwell Drummond was born in Perth, Western Australia, on 2 June 1894 and served in the Royal Air Force from Australia. The page calls him an Australian air ace credited with eight victories on the Western Front in the First World War.

heading.zh-Hant: 中東副總司令與空軍委員會
heading.en: Deputy in the Middle East and the Air Council

body.zh-Hant: 航空遺產博物館頁面載明，德拉蒙德1941至1943年任皇家空軍中東司令部的副總司令（Deputy Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief），1943至1945年擔任訓練空軍委員（Air Member for Training）並為空軍委員會成員。AWM的紀念名冊亦記他最終軍階為空軍中將（Air Marshal），職務為空軍委員會訓練委員。
body.en: The Aviation Heritage Museum page records that Drummond was Deputy Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief, RAF Middle East, in 1941-43 and Air Member for Training and Member of the Air Council in 1943-45. The AWM Commemorative Roll likewise lists him as Air Marshal, Air Member for Training, Air Council.

heading.zh-Hant: 1945年空難殉職
heading.en: Death in the 1945 aircraft accident

body.zh-Hant: 1945年3月26日，一架載有要員的解放者式（Liberator）AL504從英國諾索爾特起飛，前往渥太華，途經亞速爾群島。德拉蒙德是機上乘客之一；該機於3月27日在亞速爾群島外海失事，AWM與博物館頁面均記他於當日殉職，享年50歲，遺體未尋獲。
body.en: On 26 March 1945 Liberator AL504 carrying VIPs departed RAF Northolt for Ottawa via the Azores. Drummond was among the passengers; the aircraft was lost off the Azores on 27 March, and both the AWM and the museum record his death that day at the age of 50, body unrecovered.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與早期軍旅
heading.en: Origins and early career

body.zh-Hant: 據AIF Project頁面，亨利·戈登·貝內特（Henry Gordon Bennett）1887年4月16日生於墨爾本巴爾溫，原在澳洲互助保險公司（AMP）任精算書記。他1908年8月14日受任為第5步兵團少尉，1912年7月1日晉升少校；1914年8月19日加入AIF，任第6營副營長。
body.en: Per the AIF Project, Henry Gordon Bennett was born in Balwyn, Melbourne, on 16 April 1887 and joined AMP as an actuarial clerk. He was commissioned second lieutenant in the 5th Infantry on 14 August 1908, became major on 1 July 1912, and joined the AIF on 19 August 1914 as second in command of the 6th Battalion.

heading.zh-Hant: 加里波利戰役
heading.en: The Gallipoli campaign

body.zh-Hant: 1915年4月25日，貝內特隨第6營在安扎克登陸，負傷後次日又回到前線。5月8日第二次克里提亞（Krithia）戰役中，他率部冒火力前進，翌日成為全營僅存的原編制軍官並接掌第6營。8月7日他參加奪取德軍軍官戰壕的進攻，兩次嘗試均告失敗；因加里波利的表現，他獲頒CMG。
body.en: Bennett landed at Anzac with the 6th Battalion on 25 April 1915 and, wounded, rejoined the line the next day. At the Second Battle of Krithia on 8 May 1915 he led his men forward under heavy fire and took command of the battalion the next day, the only original officer left standing. On 7 August he took part in the attack on German Officers' Trench, which failed twice; for Gallipoli he was made CMG.

heading.zh-Hant: 法國戰場與戰間期
heading.en: France and the interwar years

body.zh-Hant: 1916年12月3日，貝內特接掌第3步兵旅並晉升臨時准將，年僅29歲，是澳洲陸軍最年輕的將軍。他參加了興登堡防線推進、第二次布勒庫爾、梅嫩路、利斯與亞眠等戰役，1918年獲頒CB。戰後他經商並任多項公職；1921至1926年指揮第9步兵旅，1926至1932年指揮第2師，1930年8月1日晉升少將。
body.en: On 3 December 1916 Bennett took over the 3rd Infantry Brigade and was promoted temporary brigadier general, at 29 the youngest general in the Australian army. He took part in the advance to the Hindenburg Line, Second Bullecourt, Menin Road, the Lys and Amiens, and was made CB in 1918. After the war he went into business and public office; he commanded the 9th Infantry Brigade 1921-26 and the 2nd Division 1926-32, and was promoted major general on 1 August 1930.

heading.zh-Hant: 馬來亞戰役、逃離新加坡與免職
heading.en: The Malayan campaign, escape from Singapore and retirement

body.zh-Hant: 貝內特1941年2月4日隨前進司令部抵馬來亞，擔任駐馬來亞AIF司令，與英軍司令白思華（Percival）關係不睦。1941年12月8日日軍在馬來亞登陸；1942年1月14日澳軍在格馬斯（Gemas）有局部戰果，但全軍仍退守新加坡。他選擇不投降、將第8師交給卡拉漢（Callaghan）後乘小船逃離，1942年3月2日抵墨爾本，此舉引來嚴厲批評。1942年4月7日他晉升中將並指揮珀斯第3軍；1944年5月9日轉入預備役，1962年8月1日去世。
body.en: Bennett moved to Malaya with his advanced headquarters on 4 February 1941 as GOC AIF Malaya, with poor relations with the British commander Percival. The Japanese landed on 8 December 1941; there were local successes such as Gemas on 14 January 1942 but the army withdrew to Singapore. He chose not to surrender, handed the 8th Division to Callaghan and escaped by sampan, reaching Melbourne on 2 March 1942, a move that drew heavy criticism. Promoted lieutenant general on 7 April 1942 to command III Corps in Perth, he transferred to the Reserve on 9 May 1944 and died on 1 August 1962.

heading.zh-Hant: 離開新加坡後與戰後評價
heading.en: After Singapore and assessment

body.zh-Hant: 防衛研究所收錄的卡爾·布里奇（Carl Bridge）論文指出，貝內特在新加坡陷落時放棄職位逃往澳洲，這個行動至今仍有爭議。AWM說他此後再沒獲派野戰指揮，戰後一項調查認為他離開新加坡並無正當理由；Collections WA則記載他於1942年4月至1944年5月在珀斯指揮第3軍。另據NIDS註釋，他的辯解書《Why Singapore Fell》於1944年出版。
body.en: A paper by Carl Bridge published by Japan's National Institute for Defense Studies says that Bennett abandoned his post when Singapore fell and escaped to Australia, an action that remains disputed. The AWM says he was never given another field command and that a post-war enquiry found he was not justified in leaving Singapore; Collections WA records him commanding III Corps in Perth between April 1942 and May 1944. A note in the NIDS paper adds that his defence, Why Singapore Fell, was published in 1944.
